paragraphs: I'm an electrical engineering student at the University of Oklahoma, working on analog and mixed-signal IC design and silicon photonics. I grew up in Laos, finished high school at Li Po Chun United World College in Hong Kong, and started at OU in engineering physics, so I came to circuits with a strong physics background. In my lab I first fabricated semiconductor materials with pulsed laser deposition. Now I'm starting on the design side, on optically bistable ring resonators.

This site is where I write up my projects: what each board or circuit had to do, the choices I made, what worked and what I'd change. Most of them are still in progress, so every page says where it stands. My resume and contact details are at the top and the bottom of the page.
